plants.sentence: Probability sampling does not remove human subjectivity: who ends up in the sample still depends on the interviewer's own judgement.
Any survey with a response rate below 60% is guaranteed to give biased results, so such a survey can never be used.
Offered the economy in a list, only 35% chose it, but 58% named it unprompted when the question was open-ended.
To take a cluster sample, divide the population into clusters, randomly select some of them, and collect data on every unit in each; Gallup first used this design in 1936.
Having less education causes respondents to agree with whatever statement they are given, so better-educated samples would be free of acquiescence bias.
